name: Local Search
description: Search the offline library (local Wikipedia ZIM archives + the user's notes, documents, PDFs and Word/Excel/PowerPoint files). PDFs are searched page by page and presentations slide by slide, so a result points at what answers. Returns compact results: id | title | snippet. Read a full document with local_read(id).

query.description: Search terms or an article title

lang.description: Restrict to ONE Wikipedia edition, e.g. 'en'. Omit it (the default) to search the whole library — passing it hides every archive in another language.

path.description: Alternative folder or file to search (searched recursively: *.zim, PDFs, .docx/.xlsx/.pptx, .md/.txt/.rst). Default: the shared library
